metadata.title: All the reasons Marvell investors are ‘freaking out’ as Lumentum deal rumors swirl - MarketWatch

content.text:
All the reasons Marvell investors are ‘freaking out’ as Lumentum deal rumors swirl
Investors are nervous that Marvell would have to pay a big premium — and wait a while for China to approve any deal
Shares of Marvell Technology are sliding on Thursday as investors assess the financial implications of a possible deal to purchase optical-networking company Lumentum.
From a business standpoint, analysts see merit to a potential combination, which Bloomberg News reported on Wednesday is currently under discussion. Marvell and Lumentum both make optical technologies and together could capitalize on a hot market for lasers, analysts say.
